card.almas_baratas.name: Cheap Souls
card.ancla_abisal.desc: The Spur's ram slows by 25% → 50% for 1.5 → 2.5 s; from III, when you cast the Rift, Spurs drag enemies into it
card.ancla_abisal.name: Abyssal Anchor
card.atraviesan.desc: Bullets keep flying and damage every enemy in their path: pierce +1 → +2 → +3 → +4 → +5 enemies; each hit deals 15% less than the previous one (min 40%); at III and V Wasps pierce +1 and +2
card.atraviesan.name: Pierce-Through
card.bala_de_alma.desc: Bullet damage ×1.50 → ×1.65 → ×1.80 and the bullet pierces 1 → 1 → 2 enemies (the next one takes 60%)
card.bala_de_alma.name: Soul Shot
card.bandera_mando.desc: +1 max escort; respawn in 16 → 8 s; from III, escorts within 15 u (20 u at V) share your shield
card.bandera_mando.name: Command Flag
card.canon_doble.desc: +1 bullet per shot each level: 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 bullets (2 parallel → 10° fan → 15° → 20° → 25°); each extra deals 60%; at III and V each Wasp +1 bullet
card.canon_doble.name: Extra Bullet
card.canon_lateral.desc: Damage 55% → 60% → 65% → 70% → 80% of the main cannon; one cannon per side; II magazine 5, III 2 parallel bullets, IV interval 0.30 s, V reload 1.1 s
card.canon_lateral.name: Broadside Cannon
card.canones_escolta.name: Escort Cannons
card.capacidad.desc: Magazine capacity +2 per level: 8 → 10 → 12 → 14 → 16 → 18 shots; at III and V each Wasp gets +1 shot
card.capacidad.name: Extended Magazine
card.cargadores.name: Quick Reload
card.casco.name: Reinforced Hull
card.cascos_escolta.desc: Escort health ×1.2 → ×1.4 → ×1.6 → ×1.8 → ×2.1 (fully heals them each time)
card.cascos_escolta.name: Escort Hulls
card.cohetes_extra.desc: Missile Barrage: +3 → +6 → +9 missiles and charges 10 → 20 → 30% faster
card.cohetes_extra.name: Extra Rockets
card.corazon.desc: 1 extra life: revive with 30% → 40% → 50% → 60% → 75% and 3 → 5 s invulnerable
card.corazon.name: Heart of the Keel
card.critico.name: Gunner's Eye
card.drones_artilleros.name: Gunner Drones
card.duracion_escoltas.desc: Timed boats last +2 → +4 → +6 → +8 → +10 s (Drones 8 → 18 s); sunk escorts respawn 2 → 10 s sooner; Phantom Armada specters +0.5 → +2.5 s
card.duracion_escoltas.name: Escort Duration
card.embestida_cadena.desc: If the ram sinks a ship, refunds 50% → 75% → 100% of the cooldown; IV: +0.5 s invulnerable; V: +1 s and damage ×1.2
card.embestida_cadena.name: Chain Ram
card.escudo_reflector.desc: While shielded, bullets bounce back with 50% → 75% → 100% → 125% → 150% damage
card.escudo_reflector.name: Reflector Shield
card.escudo_templado.name: Tempered Shield
card.espinas.name: Spiked Hull
card.espolon.name: Iron Ram
card.faro_sintetico.desc: With drones active the Gull heals ×1.5 → ×2.5; casting Drones heals everyone 50 → 150
card.faro_sintetico.name: Synthetic Beacon
card.flota_veterana.name: Veteran Fleet
card.furia.desc: After each skill, damage ×1.15 → ×1.4 for 4 → 6 s; Storm (4 skills in 10 s) deals 40 → 80/s in radius 20 for 4 s
card.furia.name: Elemental Fury
card.gatillo.desc: Fire interval (time between shots in the magazine) −6% per level: ×0.94 → ×0.88 → ×0.82 → ×0.76 → ×0.70 (0.20 s → 0.188 → 0.176 → 0.164 → 0.152 → 0.14 s); at III and V, Wasp interval ×0.95 and ×0.90
card.gatillo.name: Fire Interval
card.golpe_devastador.desc: Crit damage +0.2 per level: ×2.0 → ×2.2 → ×2.4 → ×2.6 → ×2.8 (base ×1.8); escorts too
card.golpe_devastador.name: Devastating Blow
card.grieta_voraz.name: Hungry Rift
card.iman.name: Soul Magnet
card.llamar_avispa.desc: Wasps 1 → 1 → 2 → 2 → 2; health and damage ×1.0 → ×1.25 → ×1.25 → ×1.5 → ×1.75; V: +1 bullet per shot
card.llamar_avispa.name: Call the Wasp
card.llamar_espolon.desc: Spurs 1 → 1 → 2 → 2 → 2; health and damage ×1.0 → ×1.75; V: the ram deals damage in radius 4
card.llamar_espolon.name: Call the Spur
card.llamar_gaviota.desc: Gulls 1 → 1 → 2 → 2 → 2; health and healing ×1.0 → ×1.75; V: healing ×1.5 more
card.llamar_gaviota.name: Call the Gull
card.llamar_urraca.name: Call the Magpie
card.mas_meteoros.name: Sky on Fire
card.metralla_ignea.desc: Wasp bullets burn 5 → 12/s for 2 s; when you cast Meteors each Wasp fires 2 → 5 bullets
card.metralla_ignea.name: Igneous Shrapnel
card.perforantes.desc: Armor penetration 20 → 30 → 40 → 50 → 60% (ignores that share of armor); escorts get half
card.perforantes.name: Armor-Piercing Shot
card.polvora_fina.name: Heavy Shot
card.polvora_negra.desc: Bullet damage ×1.30 → ×1.45 → ×1.60 (stacks with Heavy Shot; damage cap ×3.5)
card.polvora_negra.name: Black Powder
card.popa.desc: Damage 50% → 60% → 70% → 80% → 100% of the main cannon; II magazine 5, III 2 bullets in a 15° fan, IV magazine 6, V bullets pierce 1 enemy
card.popa.name: Stern Cannon
card.potencia_fuego.desc: Damage of all your weapons (cannon, extra cannons and escorts) ×1.04 → ×1.08 → ×1.12 → ×1.16 → ×1.20
card.potencia_fuego.name: Firepower
card.rayo_prismatico.name: Prismatic Ray
card.recarga_alma.name: Soul Recharge
card.regeneracion.name: Regeneration
card.torreta.desc: Damage 45% → 50% → 55% → 60% → 70% of the main cannon; 360°; II range 55, III range 60 and targets fireships and mines first, IV magazine 7, V 2 bullets
card.torreta.name: Turret
card.tripulacion.desc: Escort reload (Wasp magazine and the others' cooldowns) ×0.92 → ×0.65 and they respawn 2 → 10 s sooner
card.tripulacion.name: Swift Crew
card.urraca_radiante.desc: Every 25 → 15 orbs the Magpie collects, a mini ray of 60 → 100 (length 40); when you cast the Ray, each Magpie fires another
card.urraca_radiante.name: Radiant Magpie
card.vampiro.name: Vampiric Soul
card.velas.desc: Top speed ×1.06 → ×1.12 → ×1.18 → ×1.24 → ×1.30, turning ×1.08 → ×1.40, acceleration ×1.10 → ×1.50 and ram charge ×1.05 → ×1.25; escorts get half
card.velas.name: Ship Speed
card.velo_de_bruma.desc: If a hit would drop you below 30% health, it is cancelled and you become immune for 2 → 2.5 → 3 → 3.5 → 4 s (half while a boss is in play); enemies lose track of you and your first shot afterwards deals ×2; cooldown 30 → 27.5 → 25 → 22.5 → 20 s
card.velo_de_bruma.name: Mist Veil

evo.evo_andanada_360.desc: Turret V + Broadside Cannon III: every 4 s all the ship's cannons fire a ring of 12 bullets at once (60% of main damage) and the turret goes to 3 bullets. If over the bullet budget, the ring has 8.
evo.evo_andanada_360.name: 360° Broadside
evo.evo_andanada_total.desc: Extra Bullet V + Fire Interval III: 7 bullets in a 30° fan, all at 100% damage, piercing 1 enemy, and interval ×0.85. Each shot still uses 1 magazine round.
evo.evo_andanada_total.name: Full Broadside
evo.evo_arca.desc: Heals 3% of your max health per second, refloats escorts in 5 s and, below 25%, gives you the shield (once every 60 s).
evo.evo_arca.name: Gull's Ark
evo.evo_ariete_kraken.desc: Ram ×4 and every hit opens a small rift (radius 8, 2 s, 40/s).
evo.evo_ariete_kraken.name: Kraken Ram
evo.evo_armada_fantasma.desc: Escorts deal double damage and have double health; one that sinks returns instantly as an invulnerable specter for 5 s (once every 30 s per escort).
evo.evo_armada_fantasma.name: Phantom Armada
evo.evo_bala_rodante.desc: Pierce-Through V + Sky on Fire III: bullets pierce every enemy (up to 20 hits per shot), never drop below 70% damage, break plates without stopping and leave a 1.2 s burning trail that scorches anyone crossing it (25% of bullet damage per second).
evo.evo_bala_rodante.name: Rolling Thunder
evo.evo_canon_infierno.desc: Heavy Shot V + Sky on Fire III (igneous soul): bullet damage ×2.2 (instead of ×1.8) and every 5th shot is a homing meteor (80 in radius 4).
evo.evo_canon_infierno.name: Hellfire Cannon
evo.evo_disparo_certero.desc: Gunner's Eye V + Heavy Shot III: +15% more crit chance (up to the 60% cap); crits pierce 1 enemy and mark a weak spot (+20% damage taken for 3 s).
evo.evo_disparo_certero.name: True Shot
evo.evo_egida_radiante.desc: The shield reflects bullets at double damage and releases a 200 wave in radius 15 when it ends.
evo.evo_egida_radiante.name: Radiant Aegis
evo.evo_enjambre.desc: Wasps fire at least 3 bullets (20°; max 4) at 40 u and every igneous bullet explodes (15 in radius 3).
evo.evo_enjambre.name: Wasp Swarm
evo.evo_flota_eterna.desc: Escort Duration V + Command Flag III: timed boats (drones) stay until the wave ends (max 6 at once) and sunk escorts return in 4 s or when the next wave starts.
evo.evo_flota_eterna.name: Eternal Fleet
evo.evo_fuego_continuo.desc: Quick Reload V + Gunner's Eye III: reload ×0.8 more (0.6 → 0.48 s) and every crit returns 1 round to the magazine (max 2 per second).
evo.evo_fuego_continuo.name: Sustained Fire
evo.evo_juicio_prismatico.desc: 5 rays, all crits, and the Ray recharges 40% faster.
evo.evo_juicio_prismatico.name: Prismatic Judgment
evo.evo_leviatan_acero.desc: Max health ×1.5 (on top of cards), regenerates 3% per second after 3 s without damage, and contact deals 100.
evo.evo_leviatan_acero.name: Steel Leviathan
evo.evo_muralla.desc: Spurs block enemy bullets passing within 3 u and their ram chains to 2 more enemies.
evo.evo_muralla.name: Wall of Spurs
evo.evo_sanguijuela.desc: Each orb heals 10, magnet ×3 and 5% of orbs give 50 extra souls.
evo.evo_sanguijuela.name: Soul Leech
evo.evo_tambor_infinito.desc: Extended Magazine V + Quick Reload III: the magazine refills by itself, 1 round every 0.3 s, even while firing, and each sunk ship returns 2 rounds. You almost never stop.
evo.evo_tambor_infinito.name: Endless Drum
evo.evo_tempestad.desc: The Storm triggers with 3 skills in 10 s and deals 120/s in radius 25 for 5 s.
evo.evo_tempestad.name: Elemental Tempest
evo.evo_viento_cola.desc: Ship Speed V + Iron Ram III: every sunk ship or ram grants a 1.5 s gust of wind (speed ×1.25, refreshes, up to ×1.55 total) and during the gust the ram recharges twice as fast.
evo.evo_viento_cola.name: Tailwind
